ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels occupy approximately 65% of the visible surface, with low-intensity black pixels occupying the remaining 35% concentrated along margins and the central base.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white geometric regions dominate the upper-outer portions of both lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation forms a thick continuous band along the entire trailing edge and a large, mottled triangular wedge extending from the peduncle attachment point up into the median notch area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 72 degrees and a bounding-box depth extending significantly into the fluke center.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, jagged serration profile with pixel amplitudes ranging from 4 to 12 pixels; peaks and valleys are most pronounced on the medial-to-distal sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a generally horizontal sweep with slight convex arching in the medial regions, ending in sharp upward-tapering curves at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of dark circular pixel groups are visible at the extreme distal tips and along the right lobe's white-pigmented region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, roughly parallel vertical linear disruptions (black on white) are visible on the left lobe upper-quadrant; one prominent vertical linear mark is visible on the right lobe upper-quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Vertical linear rake marks on both lobes; irregular dark pixel clusters and texture anomalies at the distal tips indicative of persistent scarring.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct group of small dark focal points is scattered within the high-intensity white field of the right lobe's upper-medial region.
